response.sql: WITH nationality_stats AS (SELECT c.nationality, COALESCE(SUM(cr.points), 0) as total_points, COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) as record_count FROM constructors c LEFT JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) as average_count FROM nationality_stats) SELECT n.nationality, n.total_points, n.record_count, n.record_count - a.average_count as difference_from_average FROM nationality_stats n CROSS JOIN avg_count a ORDER BY n.nationality
